The pre-performance stable-regime Household Equity Share candidate did not improve frozen V11 on the preregistered 2017+ window: CAGR 14.450514% was slightly below V11 14.455365%, Sharpe 1.264025 was far below V11 1.515741 and below the availability-matched unconditional U.S.-completion control 1.282121, and MDD rose to 18.978179% versus V11 7.386487%. Paired 63-session moving-block bootstrap over 20,000 replicates gave P(CAGR candidate > V11)=52.905%, P(Sharpe candidate > matched)=45.300%, and candidate MDD P97.5=25.733%. Cumulative 32-trial DSR probability was 85.363%. Per the frozen stop rule, no stable-start, threshold, sign, transform, asset split, fill-fraction, or gross-target rescue is permitted. This HEShare factor and the associated U.S.-completion strategy mechanism are rejected for retrospective use.
